# odinex_server_network (Resource)

Attaches a server to a private network. The ID is `<server_id>-<network_id>`. Do not use `network` blocks on the same `odinex_server` at the same time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odinex_server_network" "web" {
  server_id  = odinex_server.web.id
  network_id = odinex_network.private.id
  ip         = "10.0.1.5"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) ID of the network.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server.

### Optional

- `ip` (String) IP of the server inside the network; assigned automatically when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <server_id>-<network_id>
terraform import odinex_server_network.web 42-3
```
